The '''Solar Thrantas''' were an elite [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] that was led by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Nezhel Othren|Nezhel "Sunspot" Othren]], earning over three hundred kills during the [[Great Galactic War]]. The Solar Thrantas were [[Battle above Saleucami|wiped out]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] above [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
